ayahs.en: Woe to every scorner and mocker
Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it
ayahs.e2: who amasses wealth ˹greedily˺ and counts it ˹repeatedly˺

ayahs.en: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal
ayahs.e2: thinking that their wealth will make them immortal

ayahs.en: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher
ayahs.e2: Not at all! Such a person will certainly be tossed into the Crusher
ayahs.tr: Kalla layum ba zanna fil hutamah

ayahs.en: And what can make you know what is the Crusher
ayahs.e2: And what will make you realize what the Crusher is

ayahs.en: It is the fire of Allah, [eternally] fueled
Which mounts directed at the hearts
Indeed, Hellfire will be closed down upon them
ayahs.e2: It will be sealed over them
